verdict.rationale: Qdrant documents structured payload filtering with combinable AND/OR/NOT clauses on points that carry a metadata payload. Its multitenancy guide calls payload-based partition filtering 'efficient' for many small tenants. Nothing in the pack shows that filtered search keeps recall or latency intact, which is the story's core qualifier. Missing for 10: documentation of filter-aware indexing that preserves recall under restrictive filters, latency or benchmark evidence for filtered queries, and independent hands-on corroboration of filtered-search quality.
